It is the whole cycle — gesture, render, effect, setRail, context change, render — so a keystroke costs two editor commits instead of one, and with an unmemoised value in railSlot's hand-maintained dependency list it is the livelock that span a worker for 22 minutes. `toBeGreaterThan(0)` stayed green through this (caught in review), which left the fix guarded only in another lane's file and only through the test outlet; the liveness assertion is pinned to exactly one commit now, measured through the shell.
